  Kernel Note:    Transfinite membership (∈) induction on a well-founded transitive class, contrasted with successor-induction (Peano 0-successor-induction Ind(X) in 3.55).
  Verification:   Verified (Kernel)

[3.72] Soundness of the theory 𝘛 (Axiom)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)((𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)→eval(𝛗)))
  Kernel Note:    Local reflection / soundness schema for the recursively enumerable (r.e.) base theory of classes 𝘛: if (𝘛, [] ⊢ φ), then the explicit formula valuation ⟦φ⟧ holds in the fixed background model.
  Verification:   Postulated (Kernel Axiom)

[3.73] Soundness of the theory 𝘍 (Axiom)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)((𝘍,[]⊢𝛗)→eval(𝛗)))
  Kernel Note:    𝘍 is a non-recursively-enumerable (non-r.e.), Henkin-complete extension of the r.e. base theory 𝘛 (𝘛 ⊆ 𝘍). Because 𝘍 is non-r.e., Gödel's incompleteness theorems do not apply to 𝘍 itself, and 𝘍 is postulated with full soundness (𝘍, [] ⊢ φ) → ⟦φ⟧.
  Verification:   Postulated (Kernel Axiom)

[3.74] Completeness of the theory 𝘍 (Definition)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)(eval(𝛗)→(𝘍,[]⊢𝛗)))
  Kernel Note:    Negation-completeness of the non-r.e. Henkin extension 𝘍: for every sentence φ, if ¬φ is not derivable in 𝘍, then φ is derivable in 𝘍.
  Verification:   Definitional (Kernel AST)

[3.75] If a formula is derivable in 𝘛, then it is derivable in 𝘍 (Axiom)
  Formula:        (∀(Γ:Ctx)∀(𝛗:Fm)((𝘛,Γ⊢𝛗)→(𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗)))
  Kernel Note:    Theory extension monotonicity (𝘛 ⊆ 𝘍): every theorem of the r.e. base theory 𝘛 is also a theorem of its non-r.e. Henkin completion 𝘍.
  Verification:   Postulated (Kernel Axiom)

[3.76] Ordered pair(Dunaev's tagged class pair) (Definition)
  Formula:        (∀(A:Class)∀(B:Class)((A,B)=(({{∅,{∅}}}∪{x|∃(a:Class)((a∈A)∧(x={{{{a}}},{∅}}))})∪({{∅,{∅,{∅}}}}∪{x|∃(a:Class)((a∈B)∧(x={{{{a}}},{∅,{∅}}}))}))))
  Kernel Note:    Dunaev tagged class ordered pair (A,B) = mark(A,1) ∪ mark(B,2), sound for arbitrary proper classes.
  Verification:   Definitional (Kernel AST)

[3.77] First projection of Dunaev's tagged ordered pair (Theorem)
  Formula:        (∀(A:Class)∀(B:Class)({a|{{{{a}}},{∅}}∈(A,B)}=A))
  Kernel Note:    Recovers A from (A,B) via tag 1 without requiring A or B to be sets.
  Verification:   Verified (Kernel)

[3.78] Second projection of Dunaev's tagged ordered pair (Theorem)
  Formula:        (∀(A:Class)∀(B:Class)({b|{{{{b}}},{∅,{∅}}}∈(A,B)}=B))
  Kernel Note:    Recovers B from (A,B) via tag 2 without requiring A or B to be sets.
  Verification:   Verified (Kernel)

[4.01] Instantiation(meta,WIP) (Axiom)
  Formula:        (∀(A:Type)∀(G:Ctx.Expression)∀(𝛗:Fm)∀(t:eval(A).Expression)∀(v:Variable)(𝘞,⟦G⟧⊢‹(∀(⦃v⦄:⟦A⟧)⟦𝛗⟧)→(let ⟦v⟧ = ⟦t⟧ in ⟦𝛗⟧)›))
  Verification:   Postulated (Kernel Axiom)

[4.02] Generalisation(meta,WIP) (Axiom)
  Formula:        (∀(A:Type)∀(Γ:Ctx)∀(𝛗:Fm)∀(v:Variable)((¬(Enc(⦃v⦄)∈Ctx.FV(Γ)))→((𝘞,Γ⊢𝛗)→(𝘞,Γ⊢‹∀(⦃v⦄:A)⟦𝛗⟧›))))
  Kernel Note:    (A theory 𝘞 is assumed here to contain only formulas without free variables, so the variable x has no free occurences in any formula of a set of formulas [|Dec(Theory.Expression)(W)|]. Here Enc(v) (μ_Variable(v) : Variable.Expression → Class.Expression) denotes the explicit typed term interpretation / valuation homomorphism mapping a typed term of sort A into a term of sort Class while respecting the fixed model and variable valuation.)
  Verification:   Postulated (Kernel Axiom)

[4.03] CoNecessitation(meta,WIP) (Inference Rule)
  Formula:        (∀(Γ:Ctx)∀(𝛗:Fm)((𝘍,[]⊢‹𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗›)→(𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗)))
  Kernel Note:    If a formula  is derived in 𝘍 from the empty context, then the formula 𝛗 is derived in 𝘍 from the context Γ. Why this holds for 𝘍: for an arbitrary theory 𝘞, concluding (𝘞, Γ⊢𝛗) from (𝘞, [] ⊢ ) requires 1-consistency / Σ₁-soundness of 𝘞 (and for the r.e. base theory 𝘛, asserting internal co-necessitation would by Löb's theorem 5.01 trivialize 𝘛). Because 𝘍 is a non-r.e. sound Henkin extension equipped with Soundness 3.73 ((𝘍, [] ⊢ ψ) → ⟦ψ⟧), instantiating 3.73 at ψ :=  directly yields (𝘍, Γ⊢𝛗).
  Verification:   Primitive / Derived Rule (Kernel)

[4.04] Quantifier “unique”(meta,WIP) (Definition)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)((!(z:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)⟷(∀(x:Class)∀(y:Class)((⟦𝛗[(x:Class)/‹z›]⟧∧(let z = y in ⟦𝛗⟧))→(x=y)))))
  Verification:   Definitional (Kernel AST)

[4.05] Quantifier “exists and unique”(meta,WIP) (Definition)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)(𝘛,[]⊢‹(∃!(x:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)⟷((∃(x:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)∧!(x:Class)⟦𝛗⟧)›))
  Verification:   Definitional (Kernel AST)

[4.06] Class comprehension axiom schema(meta,WIP) (Axiom)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)∀(x:Name)∀(k:Class.Expression)(FFI((k:Class),‹x›,(𝛗:Bool))→(𝘛,[]⊢‹(⟦k⟧∈{⦃x⦄|⟦𝛗⟧})⟷((⟦k⟧ set)∧(let x = ⟦k⟧ in ⟦𝛗⟧))›)))
  Verification:   Postulated (Kernel Axiom)

[5.01] Löb's theorem(WIP) (Theorem)
  Formula:        (∀(𝛗:Fm)(𝘌,[]⊢‹(𝘛,[]⊢‹(𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)→⟦𝛗⟧›)→(𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)›))
  Kernel Note:    Here 𝘌 ∈ {IΣ₁, PA, 𝘛, NBG, MK} is an unspecified elementary metatheory capable of proving the Hilbert-Bernays-Löb derivability conditions D1-D3 for the r.e. base theory 𝘛 (specifically D3, Σ₁-completeness, which requires Σ₁-induction and fails in Robinson's arithmetic Q; see Hájek & Pudlák 1993, Metamathematics of First-Order Arithmetic, Ch. I §3 & Ch. III; Bezboruah & Shepherdson 1976, JSL 41(2):503-512; Boolos 1993, The Logic of Provability, Ch. 2).
  Verification:   Verified (Kernel)

[5.02] Gödel's second incompleteness theorem(WIP) (Theorem)
  Formula:        (𝘌,[]⊢‹(¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹⊥›))→¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹⊥›)›)›)
  Kernel Note:    Formalized in the unspecified elementary metatheory 𝘌 ∈ {IΣ₁, PA, 𝘛, NBG, MK} (not Robinson's Q, which lacks Σ₁-induction needed for HBL condition D3; cf. Hájek & Pudlák 1993; Bezboruah & Shepherdson 1976) for the recursively enumerable object theory 𝘛. Note that Gödel's second incompleteness theorem applies to the r.e. theory 𝘛, whereas 𝘍 is non-r.e.
  Verification:   Verified (Kernel)
